title: AuthProvider::auth_header returns String; pre-stored value could be &str
description: auth.rs:108: auth_header() signature is fn(&self) -> Option<(&'static str, String)>. BearerAuth and BasicAuth both pre-compute and store the header string in header_string: String. The return could be Option<(&'static str, &str)> (borrowing self.header_string), which eliminates a per-request heap allocation for every call to fetch_session, call, upload_blob, download_blob, and subscribe_events. The current design forces a .clone() on every call (auth.rs:163, 213). Owned return type is only justified when the value is computed on-demand; here it is pre-stored.
